qe: What is the minimum age prescribed by the Constitution to be appointed as a Judge of the Supreme Court of India?
qh: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का न्यायाधीश बनने के लिए संविधान द्वारा निर्धारित न्यूनतम आयु क्या है?
o: 45 years
35 years
No minimum age is prescribed in the Constitution
30 years
e: Samvidhan mein Supreme Court ke nyayadhish banne ke liye koi nyoontam aayu (minimum age) tay nahi ki gayi hai - Article 124(3) keval teen yogyataayein batata hai: bharat ka nagrik hona, ya High Court mein kam se kam 5 saal nyayadhish rehna, ya kam se kam 10 saal High Court mein vakalat karna, ya CJI ki raay mein ek prashiddh vidvaan (distinguished jurist) hona. Iske vipreet High Court judge ke liye bhi koi aayu ki shart nahi hai, par retirement ki aayu tay hai - SC judge 65 saal aur HC judge 62 saal. 35, 45 ya 30 saal wale vikalp kisi aur pad (jaise rashtrapati 35 saal, MLC 30 saal) ke hain, isliye SC judge ke liye sahi jod 'koi nyoontam aayu nahi' hai. Exam point: SC judge ke liye aayu ki koi shart nahi (Article 124(3) ki yogyataayein); retirement 65 saal par.

qe: Who has the constitutional authority to increase the sanctioned strength of Judges in the Supreme Court of India?
qh: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में न्यायाधीशों की स्वीकृत संख्या बढ़ाने का संवैधानिक अधिकार किसके पास है?
o: The President through executive order
Parliament by Law
Union Ministry of Law and Justice
The Chief Justice of India
e: Supreme Court ke nyayadhishon ki sankhya (sanctioned strength) badhane ka adhikar Parliament ke paas hai, aur wo bhi kanoon (law) banakar - Article 124(1) mein kaha gaya hai ki SC mein 'aisi sankhya ke nyayadhish honge jitni Parliament kanoon dwara tay kare' (1950 mein 8 the, aaj 34). Isliye aise mamlon mein Chief Justice of India, Vidhi aur Nyay Mantralaya ya rashtrapati ke executive aadesh se sankhya nahi badhti - ye ek vidhayik (legislative) karyavahi hai. Isi tarah HC judges ki sankhya bhi Parliament ke kanoon se badhti hai (Article 216). Dhyan rahe - bench ka gathan (kis mamle mein kitne nyayadhish baithenge) CJI ka kaam hai, par nyayadhishon ki sankhya Parliament ka. Exam point: SC/HC nyayadhishon ki sankhya badhana = Parliament ka kanoon (Article 124(1) aur 216).

qe: Does the Patna High Court have any permanent or circuit bench outside Patna within Bihar?
qh: क्या बिहार के भीतर पटना से बाहर पटना उच्च न्यायालय की कोई स्थायी या सर्किट बेंच है?
o: No, it has no circuit or permanent bench outside Patna
Circuit bench at Bhagalpur
Permanent bench at Muzaffarpur
Permanent bench at Gaya
e: Patna High Court ke paas Bihar ke bhitar Patna ke alAVA koi sthai (permanent) ya circuit bench nahi hai - yaani HC ki saari karyavahi Patna se hi hoti hai; Muzaffarpur, Gaya, Bhagalpur aadi ke liye bench banane ki maang samaya-samay par uthi hai, par aaj koi aisi bench kaaryashil nahi hai. Bihar ka ek hi High Court hai jo 1916 mein Patna mein sthapit hua tha; aise mamlon mein rajya ka pravdhan (governor) ya mukhya mantri ka faisla nahi chalta, bench ka gathan sansad ke kanoon ya uchchatam nyayalay ki salah se hota hai. Isliye 'Muzaffarpur/Gaya/Bhagalpur' wale vikalp galat hain, kyunki aaj koi bhi sthai bench Patna ke bahar nahi hai. Exam point: Patna High Court = Bihar ka ekmatra HC (1916), iske bahar koi sthai/circuit bench nahi.

qe: Why is the writ jurisdiction of a High Court under Article 226 considered wider than that of the Supreme Court under Article 32?
qh: अनुच्छेद 226 के तहत उच्च न्यायालय का रिट क्षेत्राधिकार अनुच्छेद 32 के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय से अधिक व्यापक क्यों माना जाता है?
o: Because decisions under Article 226 cannot be appealed in Supreme Court
Because High Court can issue writs for both Fundamental Rights and any other legal rights
Because High Court has more judges than Supreme Court
Because High Court can issue writs against foreign embassies
e: High Court ki writ shakti Article 226 ke teht Supreme Court ki Article 32 wali shakti se zyada vyapak (wider) maani jaati hai kyunki HC keval mool adhikaron (Part III) ke liye nahi, balki kisi bhi 'anya vidhik adhikar' (other legal rights) ke ullanghan par bhi writ jaari kar sakti hai - jaise kisi kanoon, niyam ya sharte ke teht bane adhikar ka ullanghan. Iske alava Article 226 ki writ samanya vidhik mukadmebaji ke liye bhi mil sakti hai aur uski bhoogol (territorial) seema bhi ahem hai. Article 32 keval mool adhikaron ki raksha ke liye hai (par wo bhi mool adhikar hai). 'Kayal-appeal nahi', 'nyayadhishon ki sankhya' ya 'videshi daayre' wale vikalp is tulanatmak (comparative) vishay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Article 226 ka daayra chauhada (mool + anya vidhik adhikar), Article 32 keval mool adhikaron tak.

qe: Who was the first Dalit Chief Justice of India?
qh: भारत के पहले दलित मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice P.N. Bhagwati
Justice H.R. Khanna
Justice K.G. Balakrishnan
Justice V. Ramaswami
e: Bharat ke pehle dalit Mukhya Nyayadhish (Chief Justice of India) Justice K.G. Balakrishnan the, jinhone 2007 se 2010 tak CJI ka pad sambhala - wo Kerala High Court aur phir SC ke nyayadhish rahe aur apne kaaryakal mein kai ahem faisle diye. Justice P.N. Bhagwati aur Justice H.R. Khanna SC ke prashiddh nyayadhish the (Bhagwati ne PIL ke vikas mein bada yogdan diya), par wo 'pehle dalit CJI' nahi the; Justice V. Ramaswami ek nyayadhish the jinpar hataye ki karyavahi chalayi gayi thi. Isliye pehle dalit CJI ka sahi naam Balakrishnan hai. Exam point: pehla dalit CJI = Justice K.G. Balakrishnan (2007-2010); PIL ke pita = Justice P.N. Bhagwati.

qe: The judicial concept of 'Curative Petition' was evolved by the Supreme Court of India in which landmark case?
qh: 'क्यूरेटिव पिटीशन' (उपचारात्मक याचिका) की अवधारणा सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा किस ऐतिहासिक मामले में विकसित की गई थी?
o: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan (1997)
Rupa Ashok Hurra v. Ashok Hurra (2002)
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)
Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)
e: 'Curative Petition' ka vichaar Supreme Court ne Rupa Ashok Hurra v. Ashok Hurra (2002) case mein vikasit kiya - ye ek aisi yachika hai jo apne hi antim (final) faisle ke khilaf, uske rah jaane ke baad bhi di ja sakti hai, lekin keval teen khaas shartein puri hone par: (1) sunvai ka mool adhikar (natural justice) bhang hua ho, (2) nyayadhish se juda swarth (bias) ho, ya (3) koi gambhir anyay hua ho, aur yachika se pehle 'review petition' khaarij ho chuki ho. Iska maksad hai ki koi antim anyay bina kisi upay ke na reh jaaye; ise 'antim upay' bhi kaha jaata hai. Vishaka (1997) ka mamla karyasthal par atyachar ke khilaf margdarshak (guidelines) ka tha, Kesavananda (1973) basic structure ka aur Maneka Gandhi (1978) Article 21 ka. Exam point: Curative Petition = Rupa Ashok Hurra (2002); review ke baad hi, khaas shartein puri hone par.

qe: To whom does a Judge of a State High Court address their written letter of resignation?
qh: उच्च न्यायालय का कोई न्यायाधीश अपना त्यागपत्र किसे संबोधित करता है?
o: The Chief Justice of that High Court
The Governor of the concerned State
The President of India
The Chief Justice of India
e: High Court ke nyayadhish apna istifa (resignation) rashtrapati (President of India) ko likh kar dete hain - Article 217(1) ke pravdhan ke teht ye patra rashtrapati ke naam jaata hai, na ki rajya ke Rajyapal, us HC ke Mukhya Nyayadhish ya CJI ke paas. Isi tarah SC ke nyayadhish ka istifa bhi rashtrapati ko hi diya jaata hai (Article 124(2) ke pravdhanon ke sandarbh mein). Rajyapal ka role niyukti ki shapath aur rajya ke prashasan mein hota hai, par istifa ke mamle mein nahi; HC ka Chief Justice apne sadan (court) ka pramukh hota hai, rashtrapati ka pratinidhi nahi. Exam point: SC/HC nyayadhish ka istifa = rashtrapati ko likhit (Article 217(1) ka proviso); Rajyapal ya CJI ko nahi.

qe: Which High Court exercises territorial jurisdiction over the largest number of Indian States?
qh: किस उच्च न्यायालय का क्षेत्रीय क्षेत्राधिकार राज्यों की संख्या के संदर्भ में सबसे बड़ा है?
o: Gauhati High Court
Calcutta High Court
Bombay High Court
Punjab and Haryana High Court
e: Gauhati High Court ke kshetraadhikar (territorial jurisdiction) mein sabse zyada rajya aate hain - apni sthapna (1948) ke samay ye Assam ke liye thi, aur aage chal kar iske daayre mein Nagaland, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura aur Arunachal Pradesh aate gaye (aaj kuchh rajyaon ke apne HC ban chuke hain, par iske paas abhi bhi Assam ke saath kai rajyaon ka kaam hai). Calcutta HC (West Bengal + Andaman-Nicobar), Bombay HC (Maharashtra, Goa aadi) aur Punjab and Haryana HC ke daayre alag hain. Isliye 'sabse zyada rajya' wala jod Gauhati hai. Exam point: Gauhati High Court = sabse zyada rajyaon par kshetraadhikar; Calcutta HC ke paas A&N Islands (Port Blair circuit bench) bhi hai.

qe: Under Article 143, what is the constitutional nature of the Advisory Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court?
qh: अनुच्छेद 143 के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट के परामर्शदात्री क्षेत्राधिकार की संवैधानिक प्रकृति क्या है?
o: The Supreme Court is bound to answer every query referred to it without exception
Only criminal and military matters can be referred for advisory opinion
The opinion given by the Supreme Court is legally binding on the President
The President is not bound to accept the opinion, and the Court may decline to answer non-treaty questions of public importance
e: Article 143 ke teht Supreme Court ki 'paramarshak adhikar' (advisory jurisdiction) ka matlab hai ki rashtrapati kisi ahem vidhik sawaal ya jan-hit (public importance) ke vishay ko SC ke paas bhej sakte hain - lekin ismein teen khaas baatein hain: (1) SC ki raay (opinion) rashtrapati par baandhne wali (binding) nahi hoti, (2) rashtrapati us raay ko maanne ke liye baadhya nahi hote, aur (3) gair-sandhi (non-treaty) mamlon mein SC raay dene se inkaar bhi kar sakta hai (1951 wale Delhi Laws Act aur kai anya mamlon mein SC ne raay dene se inkaar kiya). Iske alava aise mamlon mein alag se sunvai (hearing) hoti hai aur 1960 ke aage ke treaty mamlon mein (143(2)) raay dena zaroori maana jaata hai. Isliye sahi jod 'raay binding nahi + inkaar sambhav' hi hai. Exam point: Article 143 = advisory jurisdiction; SC ki raay rashtrapati par binding nahi, aur SC raay dene se inkaar kar sakta hai.

qe: Which disputes fall under the exclusive 'Original Jurisdiction' of the Supreme Court under Article 131?
qh: अनुच्छेद 131 के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट के अनन्य 'मूल क्षेत्राधिकार' में कौन से विवाद आते हैं?
o: Appeals from State Administrative Tribunals
Private commercial disputes between corporate entities
Disputes regarding inter-state water sharing councils
Disputes between Centre and one or more States, or between two or more States
e: Article 131 ke teht Supreme Court ko 'prathmik (original) adhikar' - yani seedhe usi mein mukadma - unhi vivadon ka hota hai jismein (1) kendra aur ek ya adhik rajya aapas mein, (2) kendra aur ek ya adhik rajya ek taraf aur doosre rajya doosri taraf, ya (3) do ya adhik rajya aapas mein ek vivad mein shaamil hon, aur us vivad mein koi vidhik adhikar (legal right) ka sawaal ho. Niji companyon ke vyapaarik vivad, rajya administrative tribunal ki appeals, ya nadi-jal parishad ke mamle is daayre mein nahi aate (nadi-jal ke liye alag vyavastha hai). Isliye aisa daayra keval sanghiy (federal) vivadon tak hai, jahan raajya aur kendra ke aapsi adhikaron ka sawaal ho. Exam point: Article 131 = original jurisdiction - kendra vs rajya ya rajya vs rajya ke sanghiy vivad; niji/vyapaarik mamle ismein nahi.

qe: Who is widely recognized as the 'Father of Public Interest Litigation (PIL)' in India?
qh: भारत में 'जनहित याचिका' (PIL) का जनक किसे माना जाता है?
o: Justice M. Hidayatullah
Justice H.J. Kania
Justice Y.V. Chandrachud
Justice P.N. Bhagwati
e: Bharat mein Public Interest Litigation (PIL) ke janak (father) Justice P.N. Bhagwati maane jaate hain - unhone 1980 ke dashak mein aise mamlon ki sunvai shuru ki jo gareeb, shoshit aur nirbal vargon ke adhikaron se jude the, aur 'epistolary jurisdiction' ke teht koi bhi vyakti patra bhej kar bhi adalat ka dhyaan khinch sakta tha (jaise Bandhua Mukti Morcha, Hussainara Khatoon cases). PIL ka mool vichaar Article 32 aur Article 226 ke writ adhikaron ko aam aadmi tak pahunchana tha, taaki koi vyakti keval garibi ke kaaran nyay se vanchit na reh jaaye. Justice H.J. Kania pehle CJI the, Justice Hidayatullah ek prashiddh nyayadhish the, aur Chandrachud jaisi anya hastiyaan bhi ahem hain - par PIL ke janak Bhagwati hi mane jaate hain. Exam point: PIL ke pita = Justice P.N. Bhagwati; iska aadhar Articles 32/226 ka writ adhikar.

qe: On what specific constitutional grounds can a Supreme Court or High Court judge be removed under Article 124(4)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 124(4) के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट या हाई कोर्ट के जज को किन विशिष्ट आधारों पर हटाया जा सकता है?
o: Refusal to deliver judgments within time limits
Moral turpitude and private practice
Proven misbehaviour or incapacity
Insubordination to the Chief Justice
e: Article 124(4) ke anusaar SC ke nyayadhish ko keval do aadhaaron par hataya (remove) ja sakta hai - 'siddh durvyavhar' (proved misbehaviour) ya 'ashaktata' (incapacity); isi tarah HC ke nyayadhishon ke liye Article 217(1)(b) aur Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968 ke teht bhi yahi aadhar hain. Aise mamlon mein rashtrapati ka aadesh chahiye, jo sansad ke dono sadanon ke ek hi satr mein vishesh bahumat (special majority) wale bhashan ke saath aata hai; sunvai ke liye ek jaanch samiti (inquiry committee) bhi banti hai jismein SC ka nyayadhish, ek HC ka mukhya nyayadhish aur ek prashiddh vidvaan (jurist) hote hain. 'Samay se faisla na dena', 'niji vakalat karna' ya 'CJI ka aadesh na maanna' hataane ke samvidhanik aadhar nahi hain. Exam point: nyayadhish ki hataye = siddh durvyavhar ya ashaktata (Article 124(4)); sansad ka vishesh bahumat + rashtrapati ka aadesh.

qe: Under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968, what is the minimum member threshold required to introduce a removal motion against a judge in Parliament?
qh: न्यायाधीश (जांच) अधिनियम 1968 के तहत न्यायाधीश को हटाने का प्रस्ताव पेश करने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने सांसदों के हस्ताक्षर आवश्यक हैं?
o: 100 members in Lok Sabha or 50 members in Rajya Sabha
Simple majority of either House
10% of total combined membership of Parliament
50 members in Lok Sabha or 25 members in Rajya Sabha
e: Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968 ke anusaar nyayadhishon ko hataane ka prastav (removal motion) sansad mein tabhi utaaya ja sakta hai jab uske samarthan mein Lok Sabha mein kam se kam 100 sadasya ya Rajya Sabha mein kam se kam 50 sadasya hon - isse yahi sunischit hota hai ki prastav tuchh (frivolous) na ho aur uske peeche sammanjanak (serious) aadhar ho. Prastav sweekar hone par adhyaksh ek jaanch samiti banate hain (SC judge + HC Chief Justice + prashiddh vidvaan), jo aaropon ki jaanch karke report deti hai; phir sansad vishesh bahumat se hataane ka prastav paas karti hai, jiske baad rashtrapati ka aadesh aata hai. 'Sadharan bahumat', '10% sadasya' ya '50 LS/25 RS' wale aankde kanoon mein nahi hain. Exam point: hataye ka prastav = 100 LS sadasya ya 50 RS sadasya ka samarthan (Judges Inquiry Act, 1968); jaanch samiti phir gathit hoti hai.

qe: Who was the first female judge appointed to the Supreme Court of India?
qh: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में नियुक्त होने वाली पहली महिला न्यायाधीश कौन थीं?
o: Justice Leila Seth
Justice M. Fathima Beevi
Justice Ruma Pal
Justice Indu Malhotra
e: Supreme Court ki pehli mahila nyayadhish Justice M. Fathima Beevi thi, jo 1989 mein niyukt hui - wo Kerala High Court ki bhi pehli mahila nyayadhish rahi thi, aur baad mein Tamil Nadu ki Rajyapal bhi bani. Justice Leila Seth Delhi High Court ki pehli mahila nyayadhish thi (aur unka yogdan ahem hai), Justice Ruma Pal Kolkata HC/SC se judi rahi, aur Justice Indu Malhotra SC ki pahli mahila vakil se seedhe niyukt nyayadhishon mein se ek hai. Isliye 'SC ki pehli mahila nyayadhish' ka sahi naam Fathima Beevi hai. Exam point: SC ki pehli mahila nyayadhish = Justice M. Fathima Beevi (1989); Kerala HC ki bhi pehli mahila nyayadhish.

qe: Under Article 136, what is the nature of the Supreme Court's power regarding 'Special Leave Petitions' (SLP)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 136 के तहत 'विशेष अनुमति याचिका' (SLP) पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट की शक्ति की प्रकृति क्या है?
o: It can be exercised only after obtaining permission from the concerned High Court
It is an extraordinary discretionary power to grant leave to appeal against any judgment from any court or tribunal in India (except armed forces tribunals)
It is an automatic statutory right of appeal available to all litigants
It applies exclusively to death penalty confirmation proceedings
e: Article 136 ke teht Supreme Court ko 'vishesh anumati yachika' (Special Leave Petition - SLP) par kisi bhi adalat ya tribunal ke faisle ke khilaf appeal ki anumati (leave) dene ka adhikar hai - ye ek asaadharan aur sabse vyapak (extraordinary) adhikar hai jo SC apne vivek (discretion) se istemal karta hai; yahi karan hai ki SC bharat ki sabse uchch adalat hai. Iske do khaas niyam hain: (1) sainya (armed forces) tribunal ke mamlon mein SLP nahi hota (Article 136(2)), aur (2) har vyakti ko SLP ka seedha adhikar nahi hota - SC chahe to anumati de, chahe na de; isliye ye koi 'automatic' adhikar nahi hai. High Court ki anumati lena, keval maut ki saza ke mamle tak seemit hona, ya khaas kanoon ke aadhar par hona - ye sab iske aadhar nahi hain. Exam point: Article 136 = SC ka discretionary SLP adhikar (kisi bhi court/tribunal se, sainya tribunal ke alava); automatic appeal nahi.

qe: What extraordinary power is conferred upon the Supreme Court under Article 142 of the Constitution?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 142 के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट को कौन सी असाधारण शक्ति प्रदान की गई है?
o: Power to amend legislative schedules
Power to dissolve lower state legislative assemblies during administrative deadlocks
Power to pass any decree or order necessary for doing 'complete justice' in any cause or matter pending before it
Power to appoint Union Cabinet secretaries
e: Article 142 ke teht Supreme Court kisi bhi mukadme (cause or matter) mein 'purna nyay' (complete justice) karne ke liye jo bhi aadesh (decree/order) zaroori ho, wo paas kar sakti hai - ise SC ki 'purna nyay shakti' (complete justice power) kaha jaata hai, aur isi ke teht SC ne kai baar aise faisle diye jo samanya vidhi se sambhav nahi the (jaise Ayodhya (Ram Janmabhoomi) mamle mein ya kuchh chunav/raksha ke vishayon mein). Ye shakti vidhayika (legislature) ke kshetra mein dakhal nahi deti, aur cabinet/finance ke mamlon mein istemal nahi hoti - ye keval nyayik karyavahi ke liye hai, aur iske istemal par adalat khud niyantran rakhti hai. Schedules amend karna, vidhan sabha bhang karna ya cabinet secretary niyukt karna - ye sab is shakti ke daayre mein nahi aate. Exam point: Article 142 = 'complete justice' ke liye zaroori aadesh dene ki SC ki asaadharan shakti.

qe: Can a retired Judge of the Supreme Court plead or act in any court or before any authority within India?
qh: क्या सुप्रीम कोर्ट का सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश भारत के किसी न्यायालय या प्राधिकरण के समक्ष वकालत कर सकता है?
o: No, Article 124(7) places a total bar on practicing in any court or authority in India
Only with prior presidential approval
Yes, but only before specialized arbitral tribunals
Yes, in all High Courts across India
e: Article 124(7) ke anusaar Supreme Court ka koi bhi nyayadhish, apne pad se sevanivrit (retire) hone ke baad, bharat ke kisi bhi adalat ya kisi bhi pradhikari (authority) ke saamne vakalat ya pesh-na pesh (plead or act) nahi kar sakta - yani retire hone ke baad SC judge wakil ke roop mein kaam nahi kar sakta. Ye rok (bar) nyayapalika ki garima aur nishpakshata bachane ke liye hai, taaki retire hue nyayadhish apni purani raay ya prabhav ka vyavsayik laabh na utha sakein. Haan, unhe koi anya pad (jaise commission, tribunal ka adhyaksh, ya Rashtrapati/upar ke pad) mil sakta hai - kyunki wo 'vakalat' nahi hai; aur High Court ke nyayadhishon ke liye aisi poori rok nahi hoti (wo HC/any court mein practice kar sakte hain jahan wo pehle nahi the). Exam point: retire hue SC judge ke liye bharat mein vakalat par poori rok (Article 124(7)).

qe: When an appellate Court of Sessions passes a death sentence, what mandatory statutory condition must be satisfied before execution?
qh: जब सत्र न्यायालय मृत्युदंड (फांसी) की सजा सुनाता है, तो उसके क्रियान्वयन से पहले कौन सी अनिवार्य शर्त पूरी होनी चाहिए?
o: It requires a signed warrant from the State Governor alone
It must be reviewed by the Bar Council of India
It becomes executable immediately without higher approval
It must be confirmed by the High Court under the Code of Criminal Procedure (now BNSS)
e: Maut ki saza (death sentence) keval sune sunaye nahi di jaati - jab Sessions Court (ya appellate Sessions Court) kisi mamle mein maut ki saza sunata hai, to Code of Criminal Procedure (ab BNSS) ke teht us mamle ko High Court ke paas bhejna (reference) zaroori hota hai, aur High Court us saza ki pushti (confirmation) karti hai; iske bina saza lagu nahi hoti. Ye vyavastha isliye hai ki sabse bhari saza dene se pehle ek uchch adalat ka nyayik nirikshan ho - HC apni zameen par saza ko badal (commute) bhi sakti hai (jaise umr kaid). Rajyapal ka warrant, Bar Council ki sahmati, ya saza ka khud-ba-khud lagu ho jaana - ye vikalp is prakriya ke nahi hain. Exam point: Sessions court ki maut ki saza = High Court dwara pushti (confirmation) zaroori (CrPC/BNSS ka pravdhan); uske bina amal nahi.

qe: The Collegium System for judicial appointments in India evolved through which famous series of judicial rulings?
qh: भारत में न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति के लिए कॉलेजियम प्रणाली किन प्रसिद्ध फैसलों की श्रृंखला से विकसित हुई?
o: The Golaknath and Minerva Mills line of cases
The Berubari Union references
Three Judges Cases (1982, 1993, 1998)
The Habeas Corpus and Preventive Detention cases
e: Bharat mein 'Collegium vyavastha' (nyayadhishon ki niyukti ke liye) 'Teen Nyayadhish mamla' (Three Judges Cases) ke roop mein jaane jaane wale faislon ki shrinkhala se vikasit hui - pehla mamla S.P. Gupta (1982) mein, doosra mamla 1993 mein (jismein CJI ki raay ko praadhaanikta mili) aur teesra mamla 1998 mein (jismein collegium ka gathan 5 nyayadhishon ka tay hua). In faislon ne kaha ki niyukti aur transfer ke mamlon mein CJI aur senior nyayadhishon ki salah ko nirnayak maana jayega, taaki niyuktiyan karyapalika (executive) ke prabhav se swatantra rah sakein. Iske alava 99th sanshodhan se National Judicial Appointments Commission (NJAC) banaya gaya tha, par 2015 mein SC ne usse nirast kar diya aur collegium vyavastha bahaali rahi. Exam point: Collegium = Three Judges Cases (1982, 1993, 1998); NJAC (99th sanshodhan) SC ne 2015 mein rad kiya.

qe: Which High Court exercises territorial jurisdiction over the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
qh: अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह पर किस उच्च न्यायालय का क्षेत्राधिकार है?
o: Orissa High Court
Calcutta High Court (Circuit Bench at Port Blair)
Kerala High Court
Madras High Court
e: Andaman aur Nicobar Islands (sangha kshetra) par Calcutta High Court ka kshetraadhikar (territorial jurisdiction) hai, aur vahan Port Blair mein HC ka circuit bench bhi kaam karta hai - kyunki 1956 ke punargathan ke baad ye kshetra Calcutta HC ke daayre mein rakha gaya. Orissa HC Odisha ke liye, Kerala HC Kerala/Lakshadweep ke liye, aur Madras HC Tamil Nadu/Puducherry ke liye kaam karta hai - in sabhi ka A&N Islands se koi sambandh nahi hai. Isliye aise kshetra jahan apni rajya-vyavastha nahi hoti, wahan nazdeeki ya nirdharit (designated) High Court ka kaam hota hai. Exam point: Andaman-Nicobar Islands = Calcutta High Court ka kshetra (Port Blair mein circuit bench).

qe: Who administers the oath of office to a High Court Judge upon appointment?
qh: उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश को पद की शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
o: The Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly
The Governor of the State (or a person appointed by them)
The President of India
The Chief Justice of India
e: High Court ke nyayadhish ko shapath (oath of office) Rajya ka Rajyapal (Governor) dilate hain, ya unke dwara niyukt koi vyakti - Article 219 ke anusaar shapath ka format tay hai, aur Rajyapal ka ye kaam niyukti ke baad ka vidhik (legal) kaam hai. Isi tarah rashtrapati ko shapath SC ka Mukhya Nyayadhish dilate hain, par HC judge ke mamle mein rashtrapati, Speaker ya CJI ka koi role nahi hota. Dhyan rahe - niyukti rashtrapati karte hain (Article 217) par shapath Rajyapal se hoti hai; yahi kendra-rajya vyavastha ka ek sunder udaharan hai. Exam point: HC judge ki shapath = Rajyapal (ya unke appointed vyakti) (Article 219); niyukti rashtrapati dwara (Article 217).

qe: Under Article 222, who holds the constitutional power to transfer a Judge from one High Court to another?
qh: अनुच्छेद 222 के तहत न्यायाधीश को एक उच्च न्यायालय से दूसरे उच्च न्यायालय में स्थानांतरित करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: The Chief Justice of India acting independently
The President, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India (acting with the Collegium)
The Governors of the two concerned States jointly
The Union Law Minister with parliamentary approval
e: Article 222 ke anusaar High Court ke nyayadhish ko ek HC se doosre HC mein sthaanaantarit (transfer) karne ka adhikar rashtrapati ke paas hai, aur wo bhi Mukhya Nyayadhish (CJI) se parishv (consultation) ke baad - aur vyavharik roop se ye parishv collegium ke through hoti hai. Isliye CJI akele faisla nahi karte, dono rajyaon ke Rajyapal 'saajha' (jointly) nahi karte, aur Vidhi Mantri sansad ki manzoori se transfer nahi karte. Iske alava transfer ke baad nyayadhish ko naye HC ki parishv dena zaroori hai (jo weightage mein milta hai), aur unhe aise transfer par 'niji asuvidha' ke aadhar par inkaar ka adhikar nahi hai (SC ne K. Ashok Reddy case mein kaha ki transfer public interest mein ho sakta hai). Exam point: HC judge ka transfer = rashtrapati, CJI (collegium) se parishv ke baad (Article 222).

qe: Under Article 233, who is the appointing authority for District Judges in a State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 233 के तहत राज्य में जिला न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
o: The Chief Minister through the Law Department
The State Public Service Commission independently
The Governor of the State in consultation with the High Court
The President of India on recommendation of the High Court Chief Justice
e: Article 233 ke anusaar rajya mein zila nyayadhishon (District Judges) ki niyukti, unka sthaanaantar (posting) aur padonnati (promotion) Rajyapal karte hain, aur wo bhi sambandhit High Court se parishv (consultation) ke baad - yani is mamle mein HC ki salah lena zaroori hai, taaki nyayapalika ki swatantrata bani rahe. Chhote nyayadhishon (jaise civil judge/munsif) ki niyukti High Court khud karti hai (Article 234) aur usme rajya lok seva aayog (Public Service Commission) ka sahyog liya jaata hai. Mukhya mantri ya Vidhi Vibhag, ya akele PSC - inmein se koi bhi District Judge ki niyukti ka adhikari nahi hai; rashtrapati bhi nahi, kyunki ye rajya star ka mamla hai. Exam point: District Judge = Rajyapal, High Court se parishv ke baad (Article 233); chhote nyayadhish HC khud niyukt karta hai (Article 234).

qe: What does the term 'Court of Record' signify under Article 129 (for Supreme Court) and Article 215 (for High Courts)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 129 (सुप्रीम कोर्ट) और अनुच्छेद 215 (हाई कोर्ट) के तहत 'अभिलेख न्यायालय' (Court of Record) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: The court is required to maintain audio recordings of all witness testimonies
Its acts and judicial proceedings are recorded for perpetual memory and testimony with evidentiary value, and it has the power to punish for contempt of itself
The court cannot review its own judgments under any circumstance
The court records must be deposited in the National Archives annually
e: Article 129 (SC) aur Article 215 (HC) ke teht dono uchch adalaton ko 'Record ki Adalat' (Court of Record) ka darja milta hai - iska arth hai ki unki karyavahi aur faisle 'sada ke smriti aur praman' (perpetual memory and testimony) ke liye darj hote hain, unki pramanikta (evidentiary value) hoti hai aur unhe koi doosri adalat challenge nahi kar sakti; iske alava aise court ko apne apmaan (contempt) par saza dene ka adhikar bhi hota hai. Isliye 'audio recording zaroori', 'apne faisle ki samiksha nahi kar sakti' ya 'National Archives mein jama karna' wale vikalp is tatva (term) ka sahi arth nahi hain. Yahi darja (status) SC aur HC dono ko milta hai, jisse wo aam adalaton se alag aur upar maane jaate hain. Exam point: Court of Record = karyavahi ka sthai record + pramanikta + contempt ki saza dene ki shakti (Article 129/215).

qe: What administrative power does the Chief Justice of India exercise as the 'Master of the Roster'?
qh: 'मास्टर ऑफ द रोस्टर' के रूप में भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश के पास कौन सी प्रशासनिक शक्ति होती है?
o: Authority to decide the retirement dates of fellow judges
Unilateral power to transfer cases to international courts
Power to overturn rulings of division benches administratively
Exclusive prerogative to constitute benches of the Supreme Court and allocate cases to those benches
e: 'Master of the Roster' ka matlab hai ki Supreme Court ke bhitar bench ka gathan (kaun se nyayadhish kis mamle ki sunvai karenge) aur mamlon ka baantwara (allocation) karne ka adhikar Mukhya Nyayadhish (CJI) ke paas hota hai - yani wo tay karte hain ki koi mamla kis bench ko diya jaaye. Ye vyavastha abhyas (practice) aur nyayik faislon (jaise 2018 ke 'CJI Court Master of Roster' case) se aayi hai, aur aam taur par CJI hi ise istemal karte hain. Isse wo nyayadhishon ke karyakal (retirement date) tay nahi karte, international courts ko mamle nahi bhejte, aur division bench ke faislon ko prashasnik (administratively) palat nahi sakte - ye sab vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Master of the Roster = CJI (aur unke dwara tay bench) ka adhikar - SC mein bench ka gathan aur mamlon ka aavantan (allocation).

qe: Under Article 227, what is the scope of the High Court's power of superintendence?
qh: अनुच्छेद 227 के तहत उच्च न्यायालय के अधीक्षण की शक्ति का दायरा क्या है?
o: Appellate power over all courts including the Supreme Court on state law matters
Administrative control over the State Legislative Assembly
Superintendence over all courts and tribunals throughout its territorial jurisdiction, excluding military tribunals
Superintendence over police investigation protocols only
e: Article 227 ke teht High Court ko apne kshetraadhikar (territorial jurisdiction) ke bhitar aane wali sabhi adalaton aur tribunals par 'adhikshata' (superintendence) ka adhikar milta hai - iske teht HC niyam banane, karyavahi ki nigrani karne aur zaroorat par mamla apne paas maangne (pull up) jaise kaam kar sakti hai; lekin sainya (military) adalat/tribunal is daayre se bahar hain (Army Act ke teht banaye gaye courts-martial par nahi). Supreme Court par, Vidhan Sabha par ya police investigation par HC ki aisi adhikshata nahi hoti - isliye 'sainya tribunal ka bhi daayra', 'vidhan sabha par niyantran' ya 'police jaanch par sawaal' wale vikalp galat hain. Ye shakti nyayapalika ke pramukh ke roop mein HC ko milti hai, aur usi ka sahi jod 'sabhi adalaton aur tribunals par superintendence (sainya ke alava)' hai. Exam point: Article 227 = High Court ki superintendence shakti - kshetra ke sabhi courts/tribunals par, sainya tribunal ke alava.

qe: The 'Basic Structure Doctrine' limiting the amending power of Parliament under Article 368 was established in which historic case?
qh: अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संसद की संशोधन शक्ति को सीमित करने वाला 'मूल संरचना का सिद्धांत' किस ऐतिहासिक मामले में स्थापित किया गया था?
o: Golaknath v. State of Punjab (1967)
Shankari Prasad v. Union of India (1951)
Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)
e: 'Aadharik sanrachna siddhant' (Basic Structure Doctrine) Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) case mein Supreme Court ki 13 nyayadhishon ki bench ne sthapit kiya - usne kaha ki Parliament Article 368 ke teht samvidhan mein sanshodhan kar sakti hai, par samvidhan ki aadharik sanrachna (jaise sarvochchta, nyayik samiksha, shaktiyon ka batwara, dharmanirapekshata) ko nasht nahi kar sakti. Shankari Prasad (1951) aur Sajjan Singh (1965) ne pahle kaha tha ki mool adhikar sanshodhit ho sakte hain, aur Golaknath (1967) ne kaha ki mool adhikar sanshodhit nahi ho sakte - inke baad 1973 ka faisla aaya. Minerva Mills (1980) ne 42th sanshodhan ke kuchh khandon (Article 368(4)-(5)) ko isi siddhant ke aadhar par rad kiya. Exam point: basic structure = Kesavananda Bharati (1973); Golaknath (1967) ne mool adhikar un-manyata ki thi, Minerva Mills (1980) ne vistar rad kiya.

qe: What is the legal status of an award passed by a 'Lok Adalat' organized under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987?
qh: विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम 1987 के तहत आयोजित 'लोक अदालत' के फैसले की कानूनी स्थिति क्या है?
o: It is deemed to be a decree of a civil court, is final and binding on all parties, and no appeal lies against it in any court
It is merely a non-binding mediation proposal
It can be challenged before a District Judge within 30 days
It applies only to criminal compoundable offenses
e: Lok Adalat ke dwara paas kiya gaya 'purasKar' (award) Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 ke teht civil court ke 'decree' (nirnay) ke samaan maana jaata hai - wo sabhi pakshon par antim aur baandhne wala (final and binding) hota hai, aur uske khilaf kisi bhi adalat mein appeal nahi hoti; haan, kuchh mamlon mein dhamki ya dhokhe (fraud) ke aadhar par usse bahar nikalne (set aside) ka raasta ho sakta hai. Iska maksad yahi hai ki jhagde bina lambi mukadma-baji ke sulah (settlement) se nipat jayein. 'Mediation proposal' ya '30 din mein appeal' wale vikalp is kanoon ke khilaf hain, aur ye keval compoundable criminal mamlon tak hi seemit nahi hai - civil, vittiye aur anya mamle bhi iske daayre mein aate hain. Exam point: Lok Adalat ka award = civil court ka decree, antim aur binding, koi appeal nahi (Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987).

qe: In the landmark 'Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)' case, how did the Supreme Court describe the relationship between Fundamental Rights and DPSPs?
qh: 'मिनर्वा मिल्स मामले (1980)' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मौलिक अधिकारों और नीति निर्देशक तत्वों (DPSP) के संबंध को किस प्रकार वर्णित किया?
o: They are like two wheels of a chariot, built on mutual balance and harmony without one being subordinated to the other
They are independent systems operating under different jurisdictions
Fundamental Rights are absolute and DPSPs are unconstitutional
DPSPs completely override Fundamental Rights in all cases
e: Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980) case mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki mool adhikar (Part III) aur nirdeshak tatva (DPSP/Part IV) ek doosre ke vikalp (alternative) nahi, balki ek hi rath ke do pahiye (two wheels of a chariot) hain - dono mein santulan (balance aur harmony) hona chahiye, ek doosre ke aadheen nahi. Isi faisle ne 42th sanshodhan ke un khandon (Article 368(4)-(5)) ko rad kiya jo sanshodhan-shakti ke vistar ke naam par sanshiya samvidhanik niyantran ko khatm kar dete the, aur kaha ki samvidhan ka 'basic structure' bacha rehna chahiye. Isliye 'ek doosre ke bina adhoora', 'dono alag-alag kshetra' ya 'DPSP mool adhikaron par bhaari' wale vikalp is faisle ke nahi hain. Exam point: Minerva Mills (1980) = mool adhikar aur DPSP ek rath ke do pahiye; Article 368(4)-(5) rad.

qe: Who was the only Chief Justice of India to have served as the Acting President of India?
qh: भारत के कार्यवाहक राष्ट्रपति के रूप में कार्य करने वाले एकमात्र मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice S.M. Sikri
Justice K. Subba Rao
Justice M. Hidayatullah
Justice P.B. Gajendragadkar
e: Bharat ke ekmatra aise Mukhya Nyayadhish (CJI) Justice M. Hidayatullah the jinhone CJI rehte hue kaaryavahak Rashtrapati (Acting President) ke roop mein bhi kaam kiya - unhone do maukon par (1969 mein Zakir Hussain ke nidhan ke baad aur 1974 mein V.V. Giri ke istifa ke baad) rashtrapati ke kartavya nibhaye. Ye vyavastha (rashtrapati ke kartavya nibhane ke liye CJI) baad mein President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969 se aur spasht hui. Justice S.M. Sikri, K. Subba Rao aur P.B. Gajendragadkar apne-apne samay ke prashiddh nyayadhish the, par rashtrapati ke kartavya unhe nahi nibhane pade. Exam point: CJI rehte hue Acting President banne wala ekmatra vyakti = Justice M. Hidayatullah (1969 aur 1974).

qe: What is the official seal and motto of the Supreme Court of India?
qh: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की आधिकारिक मुहर और आदर्श वाक्य क्या है?
o: Sarnath Lion Capital with the Dharma Chakra and the Sanskrit motto 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah'
Scales of Justice with the motto 'Fiat Justitia'
National Emblem with motto 'Satyameva Jayate'
Ashoka Chakra with the motto 'Dharmo Rakshati Rakshitah'
e: Supreme Court ka aadhikarik chinh (seal) Sarnath ka sinh-shirsh (Lion Capital) hai jismein Dharma Chakra aur 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah' (jahan dharma hai, wahan vijay hai) wala sanskrit vaakya hota hai - yahi chinh bharat ke raj-chinh (State Emblem) par bhi aadharit hai. 'Fiat Justitia' (nyay ho), 'Satyameva Jayate' (satya ki hi vijay hoti hai) aur 'Dharmo Rakshati Rakshitah' (dharma raksha karta hai) anya sansthaon ya vichaaron ke vaakya hain, SC ke nahi. Isliye sahi jod Sarnath Lion Capital + Dharma Chakra + 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah' hai. Exam point: SC ka chinh aur vaakya = Sarnath Lion Capital (Dharmachakra ke saath) aur 'Yato Dharmastato Jayah'.

qe: Under Article 145(3), what is the minimum bench strength required to hear cases involving a substantial question of constitutional interpretation or presidential references?
qh: अनुच्छेद 145(3) के तहत संवैधानिक व्याख्या से जुड़े मामलों की सुनवाई के लिए न्यूनतम कितने जजों की संविधान पीठ होना अनिवार्य है?
o: At least 5 judges (Constitution Bench)
At least 9 judges
At least 7 judges
At least 3 judges
e: Article 145(3) ke anusaar jis mamle mein samvidhan ki vyakhya (interpretation) se juda koi 'mool prashn' (substantial question of law) uthta hai, ya jo mamla Article 143 ke teht rashtrapati ke nirdesh par aata hai, uski sunvai ke liye kam se kam 5 nyayadhishon ki bench (Constitution Bench) baithana zaroori hai - yani 5 se kam nyayadhish aise mamle ka faisla nahi kar sakte. Aam mamlon ke liye 2-3 nyayadhishon ki bench hoti hai, aur kuchh badi ahem mamlon mein 7, 9 ya 13 nyayadhishon ki bench bhi baithi hai (jaise basic structure case mein 13). '9', '7' ya '3' wale aankde nyoontam ki shart nahi hain, isliye sahi jod 'kam se kam 5' hi hai. Exam point: Constitution Bench = kam se kam 5 nyayadhish (Article 145(3)), jab bhi samvidhan ki vyakhya ka mool sawaal ho.

qe: Under Article 139A, what power does the Supreme Court have regarding cases involving identical questions of law pending before High Courts?
qh: अनुच्छेद 139A के तहत विभिन्न उच्च न्यायालयों में लंबित समान कानूनी प्रश्नों वाले मामलों पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट के पास क्या शक्ति है?
o: Power to instruct the President to resolve the conflict administratively
Power to order the immediate closure of all such proceedings
Power to withdraw the cases to itself and dispose of them, or transfer cases from one High Court to another
Power to form special arbitration tribunals in state capitals
e: Article 139A ke teht agar Supreme Court ko lagta hai ki ek hi vidhik sawaal (identical question of law) kai High Courts ke paas pending hai, to wo (1) un mamlon ko apne paas mangwa kar khud faisla kar sakti hai, ya (2) ek High Court ke mamle ko doosri High Court ko transfer kar sakti hai - isse ek hi sawaal par alag-alag HC ke vipreet faisle na banen. Isliye rashtrapati ko aadesh dene, sabhi karyavahi band kar dene, ya rajdhaniyon mein vishesh tribunal banane wale vikalp is pravdhan ka hissa nahi hain. Ye shakti SC ke apne vivek (discretion) par chalti hai, taaki pore desh mein kanoon ka ek saman chalan (uniformity) bana rahe. Exam point: Article 139A = SC ek hi vidhik sawaal wale mamlon ko apne paas le sakti hai (withdraw) ya ek HC se doosri HC bhej sakti hai (transfer).

qe: What is the primary difference between a 'District Judge' and a 'Sessions Judge' in the subordinate judiciary?
qh: अधीनस्थ न्यायपालिका में 'जिला न्यायाधीश' (District Judge) और 'सत्र न्यायाधीश' (Sessions Judge) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
o: District Judge is a central employee; Sessions Judge is a state employee
Sessions Judge deals exclusively with tax and revenue collection
District Judge holds trials in villages; Sessions Judge sits in the High Court
The same judicial officer is designated as District Judge when presiding over civil matters, and as Sessions Judge when trying criminal cases
e: Zila nyayapalika mein 'District Judge' aur 'Sessions Judge' do alag vyakti nahi hote - ek hi nyayik adhikari diwani (civil) mamlon ki sunvai karte samay 'District Judge' kehlata hai aur apraadhik (criminal) mamlon ki sunvai karte samay 'Sessions Judge' kehlata hai; isi tarah kuchh anya padon mein bhi yahi vyakti alag naam se kaam karta hai. Isliye 'District Judge central/state employee' ya 'Sessions Judge tax/revenue dekhta hai' wale vikalp galat hain - aapraadhik mamle Sessions Court ke, aur diwani/tax mamle alag adalaton ke hote hain. Dono padon ke liye niyukti Article 233 ke teht Rajyapal karte hain (High Court se parishv ke baad), aur ye rajya nyayik seva (State Judicial Service) ke pad hain. Exam point: ek hi adhikari = diwani mein District Judge, apraadhik mein Sessions Judge (isi tarah kai anshik pad ek vyakti ke paas).

qe: In the landmark 'Kihoto Hollohan v. Zachillhu (1992)' case, what did the Supreme Court rule regarding the Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law)?
qh: 'किहोतो होलोहन मामले (1992)' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने 10वीं अनुसूची (दलबदल कानून) पर क्या व्यवस्था दी?
o: The Speaker acts as a tribunal when deciding disqualification, and their decision is subject to judicial review under Articles 136, 226, and 227
The Speaker's decision on disqualification is completely outside judicial review
Only the Election Commission can decide anti-defection disputes
The Tenth Schedule was struck down as unconstitutional
e: Kihoto Hollohan v. Zachillhu (1992) case mein Supreme Court ne dasvi anusuchi (anti-defection law) par kai ahem baatein kahi - sabse ahem yahi ki dal-badal se juda faisla karne wale sadan ke adhyaksh (Speaker/Chairman) ek 'tribunal' ki tarah kaam karte hain, aur unka nirnay nyayik samiksha (judicial review) ke daayre mein aata hai (Article 136, 226 aur 227 ke teht). Iske alava adalat ne dasvi anusuchi ke us pravdhan (paragraph 7) ko rad kiya jo Speaker ke nirnay ko kisi bhi adalat ke sawaal se bahar rakhta tha, kyunki uske liye samvidhanik sanshodhan ki prakriya pura nahi hui thi; baaki anusuchi ko vaidh thahraya gaya. 'Nirnay par koi samiksha nahi', 'keval EC faisla kare' ya 'anusuchi rad' jaisi baatein is nirnay ka hissa nahi hain. Exam point: Kihoto Hollohan (1992) = Speaker tribunal ki tarah nirnay deta hai aur uska nirnay judicial review ke daayre mein (para 7 rad hua).

qe: From which fund are the pensions of retired High Court judges paid?
qh: उच्च न्यायालय के सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीशों की पेंशन किस निधि से दी जाती है?
o: The Contingency Fund of the State
Equal contributions from State and Union revenues
The Consolidated Fund of India
The Consolidated Fund of the concerned State
e: High Court ke sevanivrit (retired) nyayadhishon ki pension (pension) bharat ki sammilit nidhi (Consolidated Fund of India) se di jaati hai - yani pension ka bhugtan kendra ke bhandaar se hota hai, jabki unka vetan rajya ki sammilit nidhi (Consolidated Fund of the State) par bhaar (charge) hota hai. Iske peeche tark yahi hai ki nyayapalika ki swatantrata bani rahe aur rajya sarkar pension ke bahane nyayadhishon par dabaav na daal sake. Aakasmik nidhi (Contingency Fund) akasmik kharchon ke liye hoti hai, aur 'saajha (equal) hissa' wali baat samvidhan mein nahi hai - isliye sahi jod Consolidated Fund of India hai. Exam point: HC judges ki pension = Consolidated Fund of India (vetan = rajya ki sammilit nidhi par charge); Article 112/207 ke pravdhan.

qe: What does the legal principle of 'Stare Decisis' signify in constitutional jurisprudence?
qh: संवैधानिक न्यायशास्त्र में 'स्टेयर डिसाइसिस' (Stare Decisis) के सिद्धांत का क्या अर्थ है?
o: To stand by things decided: courts adhere to established legal precedents to maintain consistency and certainty in law
Courts must overrule past precedents periodically to adapt to modern times
Criminal cases must take precedence over civil proceedings
The legislature alone has the right to interpret statutory definitions
e: 'Stare Decisis' ka shabdaarth hai 'jo tay ho chuka usi par khade raho' (to stand by things decided) - iske anusaar adalaton ko apne pehle ke faislon aur uchch adalaton ke nirnayon ka palan karna hota hai, taaki kanoon mein ek samanata (consistency), purbanumaan (predictability) aur sthirata (certainty) bani rahe aur ek hi tarah ke mamlon mein alag-alag faisle na hon. Haan, adalat apne faisle ko badal bhi sakti hai (overrule) - jaise Golaknath ke baad Kesavananda - par ye asaadharan (exceptional) hota hai aur poore vichaar-vimarsh ke baad. 'Niyamit roop se purane faisle palatna', 'criminal cases ko pehle sunna' ya 'keval vidhayika hi vyakhya kar sakti hai' wale vikalp is siddhant ke nahi hain. Exam point: Stare decisis = purane nirnayon ka palan (precedent), taaki kanoon mein sthirata aur samanata bani rahe.

qe: Who was the sole dissenting judge in the infamous ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (1976) Habeas Corpus case?
qh: कुख्यात एडीएम जबलपुर बनाम शिवकांत शुक्ला (1976) मामले में असहमति जताने वाले एकमात्र न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice Y.V. Chandrachud
Justice H.R. Khanna
Justice P.N. Bhagwati
Justice M.H. Beg
e: ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (1976) - jise Habeas Corpus case bhi kaha jaata hai - mein Supreme Court ne 4:1 ke bahumat se kaha tha ki aapatkal (Emergency) ke dauran hirasat (detention) ke khilaf habeas corpus yachika sunne ka adhikar adalat ke paas nahi hai; is faisle ke aadhar par 1975-77 ke Emergency mein kai log bina sunvai band rahe. Is bench mein Justice H.R. Khanna hi ekmatra aise nyayadhish the jinhone is raay ka virodh kiya aur kaha ki jeevan aur swatantrata ka adhikar aapatkal mein bhi samvidhan se milta hai; unke is aithasik (historic) dissent ki keemat unhe CJI ka pad na milna thi. Baad mein 44th sanshodhan (1978) ne Article 20-21 ko aapatkal mein bhi suspand nahi hone diya, jisse unke dissent ki praasangikta sabit hui. Exam point: ADM Jabalpur (1976) ka ekmatra dissenting (virodhi) nyayadhish = Justice H.R. Khanna; baad mein 44th sanshodhan usi disha mein aaya.

qe: Under Article 231, who holds the authority to establish a common High Court for two or more States, or for two or more States and a Union Territory?
qh: अनुच्छेद 231 के तहत दो या दो से अधिक राज्यों के लिए एक साझा उच्च न्यायालय स्थापित करने का अधिकार किसके पास है?
o: The Inter-State Council
The President by executive proclamation
The Chief Justice of India in consultation with the Law Commission
Parliament by Law
e: Article 231 ke anusaar do ya adhik rajyaon ke liye, ya do ya adhik rajyaon aur ek sangha kshetra ke liye ek saajha (common) High Court banane ka adhikar Parliament ko diya gaya hai, aur wo bhi vidhi (law) ke through - jaise Punjab and Haryana High Court aur Gauhati High Court saajhe kshetron ke liye kaam karte hain. Rajyapal, Inter-State Council, ya CJI (Law Commission ki salah se) - inmein se koi saajhe HC ka gathan nahi kar sakta. Isi ke saath Article 230 sangha kshetraon ke liye HC ke vistar ka pravdhan karta hai, aur Article 232 ke teht saajhe HC ke nyayadhishon ki niyukti aadi ke niyam tay hote hain. Exam point: saajhe (common) High Court = Parliament ka kanoon (Article 231); jaise Punjab & Haryana HC, Gauhati HC.

qe: What does a judge's 'Recusal' from a legal proceeding mean?
qh: किसी न्यायिक कार्यवाही से न्यायाधीश के 'रिक्यूजल' (Recusal) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: The transfer of a judge to another territorial jurisdiction
The retirement of a judge before completing tenure
Suspension of the judge by the Chief Justice due to disciplinary complaints
The voluntary withdrawal of a judge from hearing a case to avoid conflict of interest or perception of personal bias
e: Kisi nyayadhish ka 'Recusal' ka matlab hai ki wo apni marzi se kisi mamle ki sunvai se hat jaate hain (withdraw) - jaise unka ya unke parivar ka kisi paksh se sambandh ho, ya unke purv paksh se naata ho, ya aisi sthiti ho jismein unke nishpaksh rahne par sandeh ho; taaki 'nyay dikhe bhi aur ho bhi' (justice must not only be done but also seen to be done) wala usool bana rahe. Recusal ke liye kisi prashasnik aadesh ki zarurat nahi hoti, aur iska matlab sthaanaantar, samay-se-pehle istifa ya nirkishan (suspension) nahi hai. Isi tarah judges khud bhi apne mamle (jaha wo paksh hon) ki sunvai nahi karte - ise 'nemo judex in causa sua' kehte hain. Exam point: Recusal = nyayadhish ka swaichchhik roop se kisi mamle se hat jaana (conflict of interest/bias), taaki nyay nishpaksh dikhe.

qe: Who served as the longest-tenured Chief Justice of India in judicial history?
qh: भारतीय न्यायिक इतिहास में सबसे लंबे समय तक सेवा करने वाले मुख्य न्यायाधीश कौन थे?
o: Justice P.N. Bhagwati
Justice D.Y. Chandrachud
Justice H.J. Kania
Justice Y.V. Chandrachud
e: Judicial history mein sabse lamba karyakal (longest tenure) Mukhya Nyayadhish ke roop mein Justice Y.V. Chandrachud ka raha - wo February 1978 se July 1985 tak CJI rahe, yani lagbhag 7 saal 6 mahine; is dauran unhone kai ahem samvidhanik mamlon ki adhyakshta ki (jaise Minerva Mills). Justice H.J. Kania bharat ke pahle CJI the (1950-51) aur unka karyakal chhota raha, Justice P.N. Bhagwati bhi prashiddh CJI rahe par unka karyakal chhota tha, aur Justice D.Y. Chandrachud (2022-2024) aadhunik kaal ke CJI rahe. Isliye 'sabse lambi avadhi' wala record Y.V. Chandrachud ke naam hai. Exam point: sabse lamba karyakal wale CJI = Justice Y.V. Chandrachud (1978-1985, lagbhag 7.5 saal); pehle CJI = Justice H.J. Kania.

qe: Under Article 144 of the Constitution, what duty is cast upon civil and judicial authorities across India?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 144 के तहत भारत भर के नागरिक और न्यायिक अधिकारियों पर क्या कर्तव्य सौंपा गया है?
o: They are immune from contempt of court proceedings
All authorities, civil and judicial, in the territory of India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court
They must report directly to the Union Law Minister monthly
They must seek clearance from High Courts before implementing central executive directives
e: Article 144 ke anusaar bharat ke kshetra ke saare civil aur nyayik adhikariyon (authorities) ka kartavya hai ki wo Supreme Court ki sahayata (aid) mein kaam karein - yani SC ka aadesh ka jaari karne aur lagu karne mein prashasnik adhikari, police, aur anya adalaton ko sahyog dena hota hai. Isi ke saath Article 141 kehta hai ki SC ke faisle saare desh ke liye baandhne wale (binding) hote hain, aur Article 142 ke teht SC purna nyay ke liye koi bhi aadesh de sakti hai. 'Contempt se chhoot', 'Vidhi Mantri ko monthly report' ya 'HC se clearance' wale vikalp is pravdhan ke nahi hain - aapko yaad rakhna hai ki Article 144 ka saar 'SC ki sahayata aur aadesh ka paalan' hai. Exam point: Article 144 = saare civil aur nyayik adhikari Supreme Court ki sahayata mein karyavahi karenge (SC ke aadesh ka palan).

qe: Under Article 128, who can invite a retired Supreme Court or High Court judge to sit and act as a Judge of the Supreme Court?
qh: अनुच्छेद 128 के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट की बैठकों में भाग लेने के लिए सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश को आमंत्रित करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: The Chief Justice of India, with the previous consent of the President
The Union Law Minister
The President of India acting alone
The Collegium without executive consent
e: Article 128 ke anusaar Supreme Court ke Mukhya Nyayadhish (CJI) rashtrapati ki prev consent (purv-anumati) ke saath kisi bhi sevanivrit (retired) SC nyayadhish ya High Court ke nyayadhish ko bulanda (invite) kar sakte hain ki wo SC ke nyayadhish ke roop mein baith kar karyavahi (sit and act) karein - aise nyayadhish ko 'adhoc judge' kaha jaata hai, aur ye vyavastha tab istemal hoti hai jab SC mein nyayadhishon ki kami ho ya kisi vishesh mamle ke liye vishesh anubhav chahiye ho. Ismein khaas shart yahi hai ki CJI ki invite aur rashtrapati ki purv-anumati dono zaroori hain; koi ek akela ye kaam nahi kar sakta. Vidhi Mantri, rashtrapati akele, ya collegium bina executive consent ke - ye vikalp is pravdhan ke nahi hain. Exam point: Article 128 = CJI rashtrapati ki purv-anumati ke saath retired SC/HC nyayadhish ko SC mein adhoc judge ke roop mein bula sakte hain.
